newsitem.title: LATVIA: STOCK EXCHANGE CONSIDERS MORE THAN ONE INDEX.
newsitem.headline: STOCK EXCHANGE CONSIDERS MORE THAN ONE INDEX.

text.p: The stock exchange will for now stick to one index tracking the whole market but would eventually like to have indices for official and secondary market shares, bourse chief Uldis Cerps said on Tuesday.
The bourse is tomorrow officially to launch its delayed official index, which was originally scheduled to begin publication in April.
"There will be one global index in the short term but in the long term it will be differential (between the various lists)," Cerps told Reuters.
The new index, which will join indices launched by local banks that track the market, will include nine shares is a capitalisation based index.
